sequential_dependency.intermediate: The normalized cell offsets of the selected smallest multi-cell 2/4 template, before those offsets are stamped at any colored anchor.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Find every cardinally connected component made only from colors 2 and 4 with more than one cell, select the smallest component, and translate its cells so its bounding box begins at row 0, column 0.
sequential_dependency.step_b: For every anchor cell colored 6, 7, 8, or 9, add the normalized offsets from step A to the anchor position and paint the in-bounds cells with that anchor color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The stamped output coordinates are exactly each anchor coordinate plus the normalized offsets selected in step A; substituting the largest component changes those offsets and therefore changes the protected-Racket final grid.
